title: PTP object downloads publish the metadata size instead of actual downloaded bytes
description:
Severity medium; confidence high; security/functional length contract. Generic indigo_drivers/ccd_ptp/indigo_ptp.c:1718-1737 reads advertised image size from ObjectInfo, then GetObject uses data_in_size=NULL and forwards the prior metadata size to preview/image. Sony indigo_ptp_sony.c:1410-1437 and Fuji indigo_ptp_fuji.c:379-392 repeat this. Transport allocates from actual data-container length (indigo_ptp.c:1387-1410, with1024 padding on raw USB; ICA allocates exact input length1150-1156). If metadata exceeds received length/padding, native publication or local save reads beyond that allocation. The sink trusts data_size for file write and blob size (indigo_libs/indigo_ccd_driver.c:2610,2629-2632). Minimal fix: request/retain actual downloaded length, validate metadata independently, and pass only verified actual bytes to all consumers. Add fake transport mismatched metadata/object tests. Distinct from active019 DeviceInfo parsing. No reproduction executed. Next: coordinator assigns scoped remediation and regression verification; full evidence/remedy in findings.md (AC-12). No fix or risk acceptance claimed.

Imported from .factory/findings/archive/FND-20261024121920-3bd2-repository-audit-027.json (category: security, blocking: no).
